priorities.summary: Code injection (CWE-94) in Dassault Systèmes' GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager (3DEXPERIENCE releases R2024x through R2026x) lets an attacker execute arbitrary code on the server, risking unauthorized access and data loss.

Deserialization of untrusted data in Apache Roller 6.1.5's XML-RPC endpoint (fixed in 6.1.6) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution; the endpoint parses requests even when XML-RPC is disabled in configuration.

Buffer overflow in an interface of HPE Networking Instant ON lets an unauthenticated remote attacker run arbitrary code as a privileged user on the underlying host; disclosed under HPE advisory hpesbnw05150en_us.

model.name: OpenAI Dots
model.summary: OpenAI's new always-on AI agents that pursue user goals continuously — each gets its own cloud computer and browser, connects to 4,000+ apps via the plugin ecosystem, and learns from feedback. Powered by GPT-6 Astra, launched at DevDay 2026 as the company's shift from chatbots to persistent agentic workers.
